mechanism_claims.entity_scope: F6 egg-yolk peptide fraction against Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 29213
mechanism_claims.claim_text: F6 treatment is directly associated with leakage of nucleic-acid absorbing material from S. aureus cells.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay is for the F6 fraction, not an isolated proof of mechanism for each individual Table 4 peptide.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Confocal live/dead staining supports membrane permeabilization/disintegration after F6 exposure.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Cell staining supports membrane damage but does not by itself define a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: F6 egg-yolk peptide fraction against Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 29213
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Electron microscopy supports visible cell envelope damage and rupture after F6 treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology is treated as membrane/cell-envelope damage evidence, not a specific biochemical pathway.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: F6 egg-yolk peptide fraction against Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 29213
mechanism_claims.claim_text: SR-FTIR measurements support changes in membrane phospholipid bands and intracellular protein/nucleic-acid associated bands under F6 exposure.
